name: GPU Particle Rendering via Geometry Shader
definition: A rendering technique that generates 2D sprite quads from point primitives using a Geometry Shader (GS), allowing for efficient particle rendering on the GPU without CPU-side mesh generation.
summary: GPU Particle Rendering via Geometry Shader expands point primitives into camera-facing 2D quads on the GPU, avoiding CPU mesh generation and optimizing performance for large particle counts.
